question:
Select the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the given word.

Deficient
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Deficient"** means lacking in some necessary quality or element; not enough in amount or degree. (अपर्याप्त)

 
 
• **Example: **The diet was deficient in vitamins, leading to health problems.
 
 
 
• **"Ample"** refers to being more than enough in quantity, size, or scope; fully sufficient or more than adequate. (प्रचुर)
 
 
• **Example: **There was ample space in the room for all the guests to sit comfortably.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Deficient'** is **'Ample'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Skimpy** (अल्प): Lacking in size, fullness, or quantity; meager.

 
 
• **Example:** The portions of food served were quite skimpy, leaving everyone still hungry.
 
 
 
• **Broken** (टूटा हुआ): Separated into parts or pieces due to being damaged.
 
 
• **Example:** The broken vase lay in fragments on the floor.
 
 
 
• **Terrible** (भयानक): Extremely or distressingly bad or serious.
 
 
• **Example:** The weather was so terrible that we decided to stay indoors all day.
